description: Upscales a supplied video segment to a selected output resolution while preserving its aspect ratio. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

assets.description: Source video for the upscale job.

video_file_path.description:
Video to upscale. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

resolution.description: Output resolution. `720p` and `1080p` set the output's short side, `2k` and `4k` its long side; the aspect ratio is kept. Requires a paid plan.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

video.description: Attach the video from ChatGPT for this input.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.
download_url.title: Download Url

file_id.description: Native ChatGPT file identifier paired with download_url; not a local filesystem path.
file_id.title: File Id

file_name.description: Original attachment filename, when supplied by ChatGPT.
file_name.title: File Name

mime_type.description: Attachment MIME type, when supplied by ChatGPT.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

video.title: ChatGPTFile

name: upscale_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.
